charge_port.notes: US: the IONIQ 5 N does not have a native NACS port. Canada: the 2025 N uses a CCS port with an offered NACS adapter (Guide Auto). The 2026 N has NACS (already on file).

supercharger_access.notes: Hyundai press relay: the 2025 IONIQ 5 N gets a complimentary CCS-to-NACS adapter (US); Canada: NACS adapter offered (Guide Auto).

wheels.notes: Cars.com page for the 2025 Ioniq 5 N (US). No Canadian N source was read; Canadian N assumed the same.
